$comment2: Seeded from the ADR-002 module map in ai-pr-review-agent.html (greenfield repo, no code yet — G2 instruction: seed from the chosen architecture). Re-run graphizer.mjs --write once real imports exist to replace this with ground truth.

invariants.dependency_direction: backend/core/** imports nothing else under backend/; every other module imports inward only (toward core), never sideways or outward — ADR-002 modular monolith. observability/** is the one exception, injected as cross-cutting middleware.
invariants.outbound_call_safety: Every outbound call (LLM provider, GitHub API, Tiger Cloud, Redis) has an explicit timeout, retry-with-backoff, and circuit breaker; every retried operation is idempotent (no duplicate side effects on retry) — L8/L12 reliability gate.
invariants.structured_output_only: Every specialist agent (security/quality/tests/docs) returns Finding objects validated against the schema in agents/contracts.py — never raw prose. The aggregator merges data, not text.
invariants.single_data_spine: All durable state (memory/code_chunks, truth/review+finding rows, time/agent_events) lives in the one Tiger Cloud Postgres-compatible store — ADR-003. Redis is queue/cache only, never durable truth.
